objections.claim: Section 6b materially misstates the governing record at git:a6061953a1d3b30a49e1bb23225705a0427cf5a5: it says the six authority questions remain OPEN, prior authorization summaries are NOT_AUTHORIZED, and their ratification remains reserved to S2/S3. `docs/institutional-memory/iliad/EYE-DIRECTIVES/2026-08-28-product-1-six-rulings-final.md` explicitly resolves all six and ratifies the bounded E6 spike, while S2 runs 3–5 are AUTHORIZED. The later DISCOVERY-001 ruling suspends the old S3 implementation grant and requires fresh exact-hash authorization plus a new S3 grant for the amended plan; it does not reopen those six fixed rulings. This contradicts §§3 and 7 and could improperly re-adjudicate Eye-fixed inputs. Revise §6b to distinguish resolved/ratified rulings from the still-pending authorization and implementation grant for the amended plan.
